content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Diana Cooper (E020)
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (from Security agent; HR agent said no training info on record, but Security agent looked it up and found basic)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So max for Diana as contractor with basic training: read (not write since no advanced training, never admin).

Requested: admin. Above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Both agents recommend read. Decision: read.
